At 6db3867 L486-489 (ref_center_color) indexes ref_image_idx + R*3*THREADS_PER_BLOCK + R with ref_image_idx = 32 - R + t, i.e. element (row R, column 32 + t), the lane's own column (written by the same lane in Read), so it is not a cross-lane conflict; only L502 reads neighbouring lanes' columns (32 + t + col, col in [-R, R]). L488-490 is therefore not listed as a site.
